/bin/bash -lc "python3 - << 'PY'
import pandas as pd, re
f='/home/beeps/.local/share/idli-bench/codex/big_ledger.q5.codex.1/ws/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

lookup = pd.read_excel(f, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)
# normalize codes
lookup['norm_code'] = lookup['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
lookup_map = {row.norm_code: row['Programme'] for _, row in lookup.iterrows()}
valid_codes = set(lookup_map.keys())

def parse_money(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return 0.0
    s = str(x)
    # remove ₹ , commas
    s = s.replace('₹','').replace(',','').strip()
    # maybe spaces
    try:
        return float(s)
    except:
        return 0.0

field = pd.read_excel(f, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
field['norm_cc'] = field['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
field['status_norm'] = field['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
field = field[field['status_norm']=='posted']
field = field[field['norm_cc'].isin(valid_codes)]
field['amount'] = field['Amount (INR)'].apply(parse_money)
# map programme
field['programme'] = field['norm_cc'].map(lookup_map)
field_rl = field[field['programme'].str.lower()=='rural livelihoods']
field_sum = field_rl['amount'].sum()

salary = pd.read_excel(f, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
salary['norm_cc'] = salary['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
salary['status_norm'] = salary['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
salary = salary[salary['status_norm']=='paid']
salary = salary[salary['norm_cc'].isin(valid_codes)]
salary['amount'] = salary['Gross Salary (INR)'].apply(parse_money)
salary['programme'] = salary['norm_cc'].map(lookup_map)
salary_rl = salary[salary['programme'].str.lower()=='rural livelihoods']
salary_sum = salary_rl['amount'].sum()

total = field_sum + salary_sum
perc = salary_sum/total*100 if total>0 else 0
print('field_sum',field_sum)
print('salary_sum',salary_sum)
print('total',total)
print('perc',perc)
PY"

import pandas as pd, re
f='/home/beeps/.local/share/idli-bench/codex/big_ledger.q5.codex.1/ws/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

    s=str(x)

field_rl=field[field['prog'].str.lower()=='rural livelihoods']
field_sum=field_rl['amt'].sum()

salary_rl=salary[salary['prog'].str.lower()=='rural livelihoods']
